entities.name: Plate Tectonics
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The theory that Earth's lithosphere consists of rigid plates that move, collide, and separate, driving earthquakes, volcanism, and mountain building. Proposed by Wegener (1912) and confirmed by seafloor spreading evidence (1960s), plate tectonics is the unifying paradigm of earth sciences, explaining the distribution of continents, ocean basins, and mineral resources.
